crossRefs.note: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls…
crossRefs.keyword: through a breach in the wall

crossRefs.note: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.
crossRefs.keyword: through a breach in the wall

translations.web: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your stuff out that way.
translations.bsb: As they watch, dig through the wall and carry your belongings out through it.
translations.kjv: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out
translations.asv: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
